title: Do not waste the peace forgiveness brings
summary: Forgiveness asks to be answered with devotion. Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
takeaway: Release becomes possible when return matters more than replay.
lifeApplication: When the old sentence rises again, release it before it claims the room and choose one softer answer instead of replay.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness asks to be answered with devotion.
source.lifeApplication: After peace returns, answer it with Bani before ordinary noise takes over.
